dedupe_keys.name: materialcities dataset mapping buildings material stocks and floor area of the world s 1 8 million settlements by structures and functions

description: The MaterialCities research team publishes gross floor area and the mass of eight construction materials for buildings in the world’s settlements. Zenodo supplies CSV and GeoPackage tables under CC BY 4.0. The release distinguishes three building functions and five load-bearing structural types. It offers settlement, administrative, country and regional aggregations, plus ranges based on material-intensity assumptions. These tables can seed material-demand, demolition-waste, embodied-emissions and building-exposure simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this release. Coverage spans mapped settlements, not a field census of every structure; the publisher describes about 1.8 million settlements. A limitation is that stock estimates rely on building archetypes and region-specific intensities, so small-area values can be sensitive to classification and allocation assumptions. Spatial resolutions must not be mixed without a clear denominator. A dashboard archive is listed, but it was not installed. No data file was downloaded or mass totals independently checked.
